items.text: Nokuti njodzi yava pedyo ichibva kumusoro,
Vafudzi namapoka amakwai avo vachauya kuzomurwisa;
kurwara kwaro namavanga zvinoramba zviri pamberi pangu.
minda yavo pamwe chete navakadzi vavo,
pandichatambanudza ruoko rwangu pamusoro pavagere panyika,"
Ko, vanonyadziswa nokusemesa kwamafambiro avo here?
mubvunze kune nzira yakanaka, mugofamba mairi,
Ndiri kuuyisa njodzi pamusoro pavanhu ava,
Ndine hanya yeiko nezvinonhuhwira zvinobva kuShebha,
kana karamisi inotapira inobva kunyika iri kure?
Madzibaba navanakomana vachagumburwa nazvo pamwe chete,
vari kuuya savanhu vazvigadzirira kurwa hondo
